name: maievs-discipline-ratings|Maiev's Discipline converts Intellect into critical strike and expertise rating (#1249)
contract: Maiev's Discipline 680233 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, Level 20 passive) has two SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT (220) effects with EffectMiscValueB 3 (Intellect): effect 0 has EffectMiscValue 1792 = bits 8, 9, 10 (CR_CRIT_MELEE, CR_CRIT_RANGED, CR_CRIT_SPELL) and EffectBasePoints 11 (12 with DieSides 1); effect 1 has EffectMiscValue 8388608 = bit 23 (CR_EXPERTISE) and EffectBasePoints 9 (10). That matches 'critical strike rating by 12% of your Intellect and your expertise by 10% of your Intellect'. Native path only: Player::UpdateRating adds int32(CalculatePct(GetStat(miscValueB), amount)) to every rating in the mask, and Player::UpdateStats/UpdateAllStats re-run it when Intellect moves. Level-80 Intellect is not a value this scenario may assume, so the assertions are relative: control and talent are the same race, class and level and have the same Intellect and no gear, so talent minus control is exactly the talent's contribution. Expertise gain = 10% of Intellect, each crit rating gain = 12% of Intellect, so the crit gain divided by the expertise gain must be 1.2 (a window of 1.1 to 1.3 absorbs the int32 truncation of each side, which is at most one point on a gain of roughly ten or more). The ratio metric comparison is over the same metric (combat_rating) with a different rating index, which the runner accepts. The aura tooltip of this record words the crit part as crit chance; the spell description (rating) is what the record delivers and what is asserted.
